limitations: Original notebook page-selection UI, font family, five exact aspect sizes and full-operation video remain unverified.
Physical iPhone GPS/background behavior, system permissions, AirDrop and multiple-finger gestures remain unverified.
Web screenshots are Chromium mobile emulation; WebKit tests run on Linux.
The About screen retains its October29 date for the older source list; November10 research is documented separately.
A reported empty destination pill was retracted after exact-image reinspection and white-pixel verification; no false corrective edit was applied.
